question: Why does poison not enter the body even when one is bitten by great serpents?
premises: Poison does not enter the body.
Even a bitten person is included.
inference: The verse claims poison fails to enter the body despite great serpent bites.
uncertainties: Whether daṃśito modifies subject or person.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even when one is bitten by great serpents.
